variables.name: P_CT_MR_TYPE
variables.comment: This value of "TYPE" s used with Content-Type: multipart/related

variables.name: P_CONTENT_TRANSFER_ENCODING
variables.comment: The next header is unassigned header, use reserved header(0x48) value.

variables.name: DISPOSITION_FROM_DATA
variables.comment:
* Value of disposition can be set to PduPart when the value is octet in
      * the PDU.
      * "from-data" instead of Form-data<Octet 128>.
      * "attachment" instead of Attachment<Octet 129>.
      * "inline" instead of Inline<Octet 130>.

      *
      * @param data the data

methods.comment:

methods.comment: * @return The length of the data, if this object have data, else 0.
